lines: Seat 1 chooses Hexer: at the end, 1 point per Scorch or Blight cast, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Wild tile at (0, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Golemwright: at the end, 1 point per 3 Golems you have, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 3) for 3 mana.
A tie for the Wild tile at (0, 0) (yields 2) at 3 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 gets the Wild tile at (0, 0) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (-1, 0) (yields 0) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 4 mana on the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 3 wins the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 4) for 3 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 2) for 4 mana.
Seat 2 gets the Steady tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (1, -1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 3 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 1 wins the Steady tile at (1, -1) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 2 wins the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 3 wins the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 4) for 3 mana.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Seat 1's trait is Hexer.
Seat 2's trait is Golemwright.
Seat 3's trait is Wildheart.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 7 mana.
Seat 3 collects 8 mana.
Attune the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) for 10 mana, leaving 1. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Cast Blight for 3 mana: the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 3) yields nothing in the next round's income.
Summon 3 Imps at (1, 0) for 3 mana, leaving 6.
All together: 6 mana, leaving 3.
Round 1.
Seat 2 attunes the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) for 10 mana.
Seat 3 attunes the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2) for 10 mana.
Seat 1 summons 3 Imps at (1, 0).
Seat 1 casts Blight on the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 3): it yields nothing next round.
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Round 2 of 8 begins.
An Unveil reveals the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2); the Steady tile at (0, 2) (yields 2); the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 3); the Wild tile at (0, 1) (yields 0, guarded by power 3).
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 3 collects 10 mana.
Summon 3 Golems at (1, 1) for 6 mana, leaving 1.
Cast Blight for 3 mana: the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 3) yields nothing in the next round's income.

Attack the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) (Seat 2's, held by no units, power 0) with 3 Imps (power 3). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 3 Imps. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 3 mana, leaving 6.
Round 2.
Seat 2 summons 3 Golems at (1, 1).
Seat 3 summons 5 Imps at (-1, 0).
Seat 1 casts Blight on the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 3): it yields nothing next round.
Seat 1 (3 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2), Seat 2's, held by no units: power 3 against 0.
Seat 1 takes (2, 0) with 3 Imps.
Seat 1 banks 4 points (1 for land, 1 for mana, 2 for conquest), 5 in all.
Seat 2 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 3 in all.
Seat 3 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 3 in all.
Round 3 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 8 mana.
Seat 2 collects 4 mana.
Seat 2 pays 3 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 10 mana.

Attack the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) (Seat 1's, held by 3 Imps, power 3) with 2 Golems (power 6). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 1 Golem. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
Cast Ward for 3 mana: (1, 0) defends with 3 more power this round.
Summon 7 Imps at (1, 0) for 7 mana, leaving 7.
All together: 10 mana, leaving 4.
Round 3.
Seat 1 summons 7 Imps at (1, 0).
Seat 1 casts Ward on (1, 0): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 3 (5 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2), Seat 2's, held by no units: power 5 against 0.
Seat 3 takes (-2, 0) with 5 Imps.
Seat 2 (2 Golems) attack the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2), Seat 1's, held by 3 Imps: power 6 against 3.
Seat 2 takes (2, 0) with 1 Golem.
Seat 1 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 7 in all.
Seat 2 banks 3 points (1 for land, 0 for mana, 2 for conquest), 6 in all.
Seat 3 banks 5 points (2 for land, 1 for mana, 2 for conquest), 8 in all.
Round 4 of 8 begins.
An Unveil reveals the Shifting tile at (0, -1) (yields 1); the Wild tile at (2, -2) (yields 2); the Shifting tile at (-1, -1) (yields 2).
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 7 mana.
Seat 2 pays 2 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 12 mana.
Summon 3 Golems at (1, 1) for 6 mana, leaving 1.
Cast Ward for 3 mana: (1, 0) defends with 3 more power this round.

Attack the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) (Seat 2's, held by 1 Golem, power 3) with 4 Imps (power 4). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 1 Imp. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 3 mana, leaving 7.
Round 4.
Seat 2 summons 3 Golems at (1, 1).
Seat 1 casts Ward on (1, 0): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 3 (5 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2), Seat 2's, held by no units: power 5 against 0.
Seat 3 takes (-2, 1) with 5 Imps.
Seat 1 (4 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2), Seat 2's, held by 1 Golem: power 4 against 3.
Seat 1 takes (2, 0) with 1 Imp.
Seat 1 banks 3 points (1 for land, 0 for mana, 2 for conquest), 10 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (0 for land, 1 for mana), 7 in all.
Seat 3 banks 6 points (2 for land, 2 for mana, 2 for conquest), 14 in all.
Round 5 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 8 mana.
Seat 2 collects 3 mana.
Seat 2 pays 4 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 14 mana.

Attack the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 2) (Seat 1's, held by 3 Imps, power 3) with 4 Golems (power 12). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 3 Golems. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
Move 3 Imps from (1, 0) to (1, -1).
Cast Blight for 3 mana: the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 3) yields nothing in the next round's income.

Attack the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2) (Seat 3's, held by no units, power 0) with 3 Imps (power 3). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 3 Imps. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 3 mana, leaving 12.
Round 5.
Seat 1 moves 1 group of units.
Seat 3 builds a Shrine on (-1, 2).
Seat 1 casts Blight on the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 3): it yields nothing next round.
Seat 1 (3 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2), Seat 3's, held by no units: power 3 against 0.
Seat 1 takes (1, -2) with 3 Imps.
Seat 2 (4 Golems) attack the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 2), Seat 1's, held by no units: power 12 against 0.
Seat 2 takes (1, 0) with 4 Golems.
Seat 1 banks 5 points (2 for land, 1 for mana, 2 for conquest), 15 in all.
Seat 2 banks 3 points (1 for land, 0 for mana, 2 for conquest), 10 in all.
Seat 3 banks 3 points (2 for land, 1 for mana), 17 in all.
Round 6 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 8 mana.
Seat 2 collects 2 mana.
Seat 2 pays 2 mana upkeep.
Seat 2 can't pay for 2 Golems: they dissolve.
Seat 3 collects 13 mana.

Attack the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) (Seat 1's, held by 1 Imp, power 1) with 1 Golem (power 3). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 1 Golem. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
Cast Scorch for 18 mana: burn 2 Golems at (1, 0) (power 6), leaving no units; you pay 3 per power that burns, so less if units move away first.

Attack the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 4) (Seat 3's, held by no units, power 0) with 3 Imps (power 3). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 3 Imps. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 18 mana, leaving 2.
Round 6.
Seat 3 builds a Tower on (0, -2).
Seat 1 casts Scorch on (1, 0): 2 Golems burn, for 18 mana.
Seat 3 casts Ward on (0, -2): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 2's attack on (2, 0) has no units left to send.
Seat 1 (3 Imps) attack the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 4), Seat 3's, held by no units: power 3 against 5.
The attack fails: the attackers are wiped out. The defenders keep no units.
Seat 1 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 17 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 11 in all.
Seat 3 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 19 in all.
Round 7 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 8 mana.
Seat 2 collects 5 mana.
Seat 3 collects 13 mana.
Build a Tower on the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 2) for 5 mana, leaving 0: the tile defends with 2 more power, even with no units on it. It is worth 1 point at the end to whoever holds the tile.
